name: Babelbeez – AI Voice Agent & Smart Call Button (Powered by OpenAI Realtime)
author: Oliver Cheung

sections.description:
The First AI Voice Agent That Actually Interrupts You

Most “Voice Chatbots” for WordPress are just text bots with a “Dictation Mode.” You speak, you wait for transcription, the bot thinks, and then a robot voice reads text back to you. It feels like a bad walkie-talkie connection.

Babelbeez is different.
We are the first Native Speech-to-Speech AI Voice Agent. Powered by OpenAI’s Realtime API, Babelbeez listens and responds instantly. It understands emotion. It allows users to interrupt. It captures the nuance of human conversation.

Zero setup risk. We protect your wallet by handling all OpenAI connections. You never have to worry about token overages or surprise bills.

🏆 THE COMPARISON (Don’t settle for lag)

Customer Feeling
– ❌ Others (Legacy Dictation): Frustrating. Like talking to an old GPS. High latency.
– ✅ Babelbeez (Realtime): Natural. Like a phone call. Instant response.

Financial Risk
– ❌ Others: High. You use your own API keys. One viral attack = huge bill.
– ✅ Babelbeez: Zero. We handle the keys. Flat monthly rate. Safe.

Setup Time
– ❌ Others: Hours. Complex vector DBs & API keys.
– ✅ Babelbeez: Minutes. Paste URL. Auto-crawl. Done.

🚀 BUILT FOR BUSINESS & AGENCIES

Whether you manage one site or fifty, Babelbeez is designed to be “Client-Safe.”

  • Cloud-Managed Intelligence (Tamper-Proof):
    The “Brain” (Knowledge, Prompts, Voice Settings) lives on your secure Babelbeez dashboard, not inside the WordPress database. This prevents clients from accidentally breaking the agent’s personality.
  • Auto-RAG (Instant Training):
    Don’t waste hours copy-pasting FAQs. Just enter the Home Page URL. Our crawler automatically scans the site structure, ingests business hours, services, and pricing, and trains the Voice Agent instantly.
  • No “Bill Shock” Liability:
    We handle the infrastructure. You don’t need to manage OpenAI keys, monitor token usage, or debug database connections. You pay one flat rate.

✨ KEY FEATURES

  • Native Realtime Voice: The only plugin using OpenAI’s gpt-realtime for true conversation.
  • Smart Call Button: Replaces the old “Click to Call” button. Customers talk directly in the browser—no phone bill, no carrier fees.
  • No Awkward Silence: Latency so low it feels like a live human on the other end.
  • Human Handoff: If the AI gets stuck, it captures the lead’s email or forwards them to WhatsApp so you never lose a sale.
  • Multilingual: Automatically detects the visitor’s language and switches instantly.
  • Spam Protection: Acts as a gatekeeper. No more robo-dialers ringing your personal phone.

HOW IT WORKS

  1. Install: Click “Install Now” and activate.
  2. Create: Sign up for a free account inside the plugin settings.
  3. Train: Paste your website link. We build the agent’s knowledge automatically.
  4. Live: The Smart Call Button appears on your site immediately.

Note: All configuration (knowledge, behavior, prompts, routing) happens on the Babelbeez platform. This plugin is the connector that embeds your configured agent.

Third-Party Services and Data

This plugin requires a connection to the Babelbeez service to function. By using this plugin, you agree to the terms of the following third-party services:

  • Babelbeez (https://www.babelbeez.com): The primary service that powers the voice agent. It handles the creation, configuration, and management of your voice agents. Your API key is sent to this service for authentication. See:

    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  • OpenAI (https://openai.com): Babelbeez is built on OpenAI’s AI models. During a conversation, the real-time audio stream from the user is sent to OpenAI for processing to generate a response.

This plugin does not track any user data on your WordPress server beyond storing configuration options (such as your API key and selected agent ID). All conversation processing is handled by the services listed above and is subject to their respective privacy policies.

Shortcodes

Use the shortcode to embed on specific pages when Load Site-wide is disabled.

Basic:
[babelbeez_voice_ai]

With an explicit agent (overrides the saved selection):
[babelbeez_voice_ai id=”PUBLIC_CHATBOT_ID”]

Privacy

  • This plugin stores your Babelbeez API key and selected agent ID in your site’s options table.
  • Conversations and related processing are handled by Babelbeez and OpenAI. Please review:
    • Privacy Policy
    • Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Upload the babelbeez-voice-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress “Plugins” screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new “Babelbeez” menu in your WordPress admin.
  4. In your Babelbeez Dashboard, open your voice agent and find your API Key in the “Go Live” / “Embed” section.
  5. Paste your API key into the Babelbeez settings page. IMPORTANT: Do not save yet.
  6. Click the Fetch Voice Agents button next to the key field.
  7. Select your desired voice agent from the dropdown list that appears.
  8. Click Save & Make Live. Your voice agent is now live on your site.
  9. Optional: Uncheck Load Site-wide if you only want the agent to load on certain pages via the shortcode.
sections.faq:
Is this a real phone number?

No. It connects via the internet (similar to a Zoom call or WhatsApp Audio), so there are no traditional phone bills or geographic restrictions.

Do I need my own OpenAI API Key?

No. Unlike other plugins, Babelbeez is an all-inclusive platform. We manage the OpenAI keys, the vector database, and the latency optimization. You pay one simple subscription. No surprise bills.

Is it really real-time?

Yes. We use OpenAI’s newest gpt-realtime model. There is no “transcription” step (Speech-to-Text), so the latency is negligible. It feels like a live conversation, not a dictation machine.

Can I use this on client sites?

Yes. Babelbeez is designed for agencies. You can manage multiple agents from one dashboard and deploy them to different client sites easily using this plugin.

How do I only show the agent on certain pages?

Uncheck Load Site-wide on the Babelbeez settings page, then add the [babelbeez_voice_ai] shortcode to the pages where you want it to appear.

Is this a WordPress chatbot plugin?

Yes. Babelbeez is a voice-first chatbot for WordPress. It provides AI customer service via real-time voice and can complement or replace text-based live chat.

Can it act as my AI customer service plugin?

Yes—answer FAQs, pre-qualify leads, triage support, capture details, and escalate to human agents when needed.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 6.9.
  • Improved uninstall cleanup globals naming to satisfy Plugin Check.

1.1.2

  • Admin banner updated to 1544×500 and UI reference updated.
  • Readme: improved SEO (5 tags), added FAQs and expanded features.
  • Added screenshots 1–3 and captions.

1.1.1

  • Removed discouraged load_plugin_textdomain; rely on WordPress.org auto-loading (WP 4.6+).
  • Replaced direct database query in uninstall with get_sites() for multisite cleanup.

1.1.0

  • New: One-save setup. Enter API key, click “Fetch Voice Agents” (no save required), choose agent, then “Save & Make Live”.
  • New: Polished admin UI with banner and clearer step-by-step flow.
  • New: Optional shortcode [babelbeez_voice_ai] for per-page embedding; “Load Site-wide” toggle added.
  • New: Loader script marked defer and canonicalized to https://www.babelbeez.com/... for faster loading.
  • New: Uninstall cleanup removes options. Text domain loading for translations.

1.0.1

  • Tweak: Added third-party service disclosure to readme to comply with WordPress.org guidelines.
  • Tweak: Renamed main plugin file to match slug babelbeez-voice-ai.php.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
